questions.prompt: What distinguishes the tangzhong method of making soft bread?

choices.text: Cooking part of the flour and liquid into a paste first

questions.prompt: Why can bread firm up even inside a sealed bag that prevents most moisture loss?

choices.text: Its gluten enzymes convert starch into protein
Its starch irreversibly breaks into simple sugars

questions.hint: Staling involves structural changes, not simply drying out.
questions.explanation: Starch retrogradation is the reassociation of gelatinized starch molecules. It contributes to crumb firming even without substantial water loss.
